name: Short-liquidation exhaustion fade
hypothesis: Short an eligible perpetual after a short-liquidation burst ends and spot price fails its new high.
spec: Setup: A squeeze may reverse when forced buyers finish. Entry: Short an eligible perpetual after a short-liquidation burst ends and spot price fails its new high. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Cover on renewed squeeze conditions or the predeclared mean/time target. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
